question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The priest puts some ________ water on the child's head.
solution:
The correct answer is: **holy**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Hairy **means covered with hair or having a lot of hair. (बालों से ढका हुआ या बहुत अधिक बालों वाला)
 
• **Holy **means sacred or related to a deity or religion. (पवित्र या किसी देवता या धर्म से संबंधित)
 
• **Haughty **means arrogantly superior or disdainful. (अहंकारपूर्वक श्रेष्ठ या तिरस्कारपूर्ण)
 
• **Wholly **means entirely or completely. (पूरी तरह से)
 
 
 
• ​The sentence is describing a religious ceremony, so the appropriate word to describe the water used would be "**holy**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence:** *The priest puts some holy __water on the child's head. *
